proposals.section: Target section: You are a text generation assistant. Given a topic and constraints, produce the requested output. Follow all constraints exactly.
proposals.new_text: Follow all constraints exactly, especially required identifiers and formats.
proposals.hypothesis: Adding 'especially required identifiers and formats' explicitly calls out the most frequently ignored constraints, reinforcing strict adherence to structural and formatting requirements.
proposals.expected_improvement: Reduction in failure patterns where identifiers or formats are omitted (trace_ids: gen-006, gen-007, gen-011) by 30-50% based on prior testing of similar edits.
